content: Tsahama nggi ƙǝla tsaha ni Ƙǝrǝsti.
Tsaharhaha aten nggǝlanda teena
Niyi a fal kun ƙǝsǝr nun naarha ɗal nggi teena, ƙǝsǝr ƙǝsɗun tsahadɗaha tǝ ƙǝkafek ˈwani tsahang kun ha ƙǝla malang ni ndǝn kun ha.
Amma na minnasǝ a sǝnunsǝ turi hǝshneefa ndǝna Ƙǝrǝsti. Turi nuneefa ƙǝm ndǝna chimarha, turi Ƙǝrǝsti ƙǝm ndǝna Faara.
Kala hǝshneefa hwangga Faara nduwa thlǝkka ˈya kyadna Faara tenggǝn nggǝnggǝla sarang ɗǝ turighǝn ɗǝ.
Kala nuneefa hwangga Faara nduwa thlǝkka ˈya ndaana Faara tenggǝn tsahai, sarang nǝn turighǝn ɗǝ nǝghǝn tal a thlǝrɗang ɗǝ tenggǝn ɗǝ.
A mbǝ mid nuneefa sǝ ƙǝnanggǝn tenggǝn wa, nǝn mbang tsaɗang was tenggǝn ɗǝ. Amma tsaunǝn ǝn shilee a fad nuneefa a tsaɗang ɗǝ was tenggǝn ɗǝ, nduwa thlǝrɗanggǝn ɗǝ, kamɗǝ a ƙǝnanggǝn tenggǝn.
Kamngwa hǝshneefa lǝlǝɓanggǝn wasghǝn wa, ƙǝsǝr nǝghǝn ƙǝla tǝ ƙǝm mamnggit Faara ni. Amma nuneefa nǝghǝn a kyad mamnggit hǝshneefa.
Kyawa hǝshneefa ɓa a fad nuneefa wa, amma nuneefa ndǝn kyaghǝn ɓa a fad hǝshneefa.
Əna wanda hǝshneefa ka nuneefa wa, amma ǝnagha nda nuneefa ka hǝshneefa.
Ƙǝsǝr ka fathlǝngya Faara, a lǝlǝɓangga nuneefa tenggǝn a kyad ndaarha nǝn nǝghǝn a kamu sǝsǝmnda chimadghǝn.
Amma hu Chinǝm mbǝ nuneefa naarha katenggǝn kula hǝshneefa wa, hǝshneefa ƙǝm mbǝ naarha katenggǝn kula nuneefa wa.
Ƙǝsǝr ǝnagha nda nuneefa a fad hǝshneefa, hǝshneefa ƙǝm nuneefa nggǝtgha ndǝn, ǝnggini heu ya Faara ndǝn ǝnagha ndǝn.
Ƙǝlaman tafad nun. Mǝmǝlni ana nuneefa a hwan Faara mal tenggǝnǝn tsahai?
Ən tiina tsahang ɗa ndǝn ƙǝm ha tǝ ndaarha ǝn shilee ni ana was ten hǝshneefa hǝling.
Nǝghǝn ngga a fad nuneefa ana was tenggǝn dzang, ƙǝsǝr fǝrang nanda wasa dzang ka a ƙǝnanggǝn tenggǝn.
Ana niifasǝ na tǝ ngaala mii atenggǝn, mbǝ ǝna ˈya sǝ ɗǝɗamǝn hu ƙǝn hwan Faara wa.
Sǝɓang nda ǝnnadmid Chinǝm ɗǝ
Aten ǝngginiya, fal yi kun wa. Mbǝ ka ˈyasǝ ngga hu wum ndǝnun hai wa, nǝghǝn ka kee.
A katǝradghǝn sǝkɗi ndaarha a wum ɗun hai hu ƙǝn hwan Faara nun kyad ɗǝɗamǝn nggirha, niyi a ndaarha nǝghǝn ƙǝkafek.
Ƙǝsǝr tǝtani a nagha kyad ɗǝɗamǝn nggirha sǝ a pathlang nun, tǝna niifa sǝnang fingya hai na ahur nun na tǝ ƙǝkafek fa kaan.
A sayidɗi wum nun hai heu a mbǝrha tal mbǝ nana mid nun ǝnnad mid Chinǝm wa,
ƙǝsǝr a naɗun a hǝbrha fingya ƙǝl yi ndan kee ndǝn na nda ǝnaarha mii mba nda hǝbrha tǝ fiya wa. Nanǝn kee niifa tal tǝ miirha fa, niifa tal ƙǝm tǝrangga mbaala in.
Mbǝ wurayinun sǝ mbuwa nun hǝbrha tǝ saarha sǝ wa? Nduwa nun a fǝrang shilee fingya mbuwana ˈyasǝ a har ndan na ahur ƙǝn hwan Faara? Mani ndang nda kun? A fal kunni wa? Ƙǝkafek mbǝ ahu yanɗiya wa.
Hǝb ǝnnadmid Chinǝm
Ənɗi fǝrang ni kun ya, thlǝyi ndǝn ɓa a har Chinǝm, tǝ ndaarha, Chinǝm Yeeso a fǝɗikɗi fǝr na ndan tǝranggǝn mburodi sǝ,
akwasamadɗi usa nǝn Faara, kyanggǝn hai, ndǝghǝn, “Fadna ni ya, fǝr nanda ƙǝsǝr ka kun. Nama naarha ǝnaarha kee tǝnun ɗal nggi teena.”
Nǝghǝn kee ƙǝm akwasamad ǝnnadɗa mii, tǝranggǝn wuhuleurha sǝ ndǝghǝn, “Wuhuleu ɗiya yi weerinda ɗǝfmiina ni tǝ kun ǝnana nda tǝ farna, nama naarha ǝnaarha kee ƙǝtsar tǝnun ɗal nggi teena.”
Kala fara kii nun mburodi ɗiya tǝ saarha tǝ wuhuleu ɗi ya, nanun a pǝr mǝrra Chinǝm ni ɗǝ, ƙǝl a nggǝr ɗǝ wutta ɓa.
Nanǝn kee, kala niifa kiigha mburodi ɗi ya, saagha tǝ wuhuleu ɗiya na yi Chinǝm kamngwa wa ǝnaɗǝ ɗimiyid sarang nda far Chinǝm ɗǝ.
Ƙǝl ƙǝlang na niifa fadghǝn ngga kapa nǝn kii mburodi ɗi tǝ saarha tǝ wuhuleu ɗi.
Kala niifa kiigha mburodi ɗi tǝ saarha tǝ wuhuleu ɗi fǝrangwa mamnggirha Chinǝm, aang nǝn ngwa kumad Faara tenggǝn fa ɓa.
Ndǝn ǝnagha ndǝn fingya ahur nun mba nda tǝ shembe wa, tǝ ƙǝm mba nda kanglang wa, fingya ma mǝr nda ɗǝ.
Amma a ƙǝlang ɗǝm fad nǝm ngga ˈwan, mba nda ngwang kumarha ƙǝmsǝ wa.
Ana Chinǝm ni a ngwang kumarha ƙǝmsǝ, tsǝtsǝl nanda ƙǝm amawa nǝm mǝra heu tǝ ƙǝshiirha.
Shayina, a wum ɗun hai heu kun a hǝb ǝnnarhami, ƙǝlama ndan hǝɓun heu.
Ana niifa sǝ na miirha a ƙǝsa, ǝna ˈya nǝn mii a wuri, amawa nun aang ngwa kumarha fad nun fa ɓa. Aten fingya ǝngya ƙǝm a ɓaɗiɓa ɓani kyaɗang kwamanggǝn kun.
